items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was influenced by Bob, the way he saw, the way he visualized the world, the way he painted

ctx.x: Bob Bunyan’s a name that comes up, I guess, in A. B.’s text [A. B. Spellman]. You probably mentioned him. Tell us about him and what happened to him.
I don’t know what happened to Bob. I just knew that he was much older than me. He was about Bud’s age and played good.
